name: code-type-classifier
body: The ingestor's code-type classifier: maps a source path plus language to a code type (src/test/generated/external), replacing built-ins with apg/config.json rules when present. Implemented today by classify_code_type / builtin_code_type in src/classify.rs; extended with .js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs rules for JS generated/bundled output.
